assertions.description: corroboration eventually fires despite slower elephant ramp (longer ELEPHANT_SUSTAIN_S)

description: This scenario demonstrates how the network handles a checkpoint that takes longer than usual to complete, generating a sustained high-traffic period rather than the short sharp burst typical of a fast checkpoint. The extended checkpoint creates a prolonged load on the storage network, but the platform continues tracking the operation throughout and confirms successful completion once the transfer finishes, even though the verification takes longer than normal. The operator sees checkpoint duration and storage network utilisation both elevated for an extended window before returning to baseline. This matters because large models produce large checkpoints, and as training jobs grow in scale, the ability to manage extended storage bursts without misidentifying them as failures becomes increasingly important for operators running frontier model training.
